caption: The drawing shows a single figure, which appears to be a doll or a puppet, seated against a plain beige background. The figure has a bright red face with exaggerated features, including bulging yellow and black eyes, a pointed nose, a wide mouth showing a row of teeth, and ears that stick out. It has a white, horn-like shape on top of its head. The figure wears a blue jacket with wide sleeves and gold trimming, a matching blue pair of pants also with gold trimming along the sides, and black shoes with white tips. Its shirt is red, matching the color of its head and neck. The hands and exposed areas of its body are a light brown color. The figure sits on a black, slightly crumpled surface or cloth. In the bottom right corner, the name "FLORIAN ROKITA" is written in black text.
title: Old Nick, the Devil
